title: Fubini symmetry of iterated convolutions: ((f⋆φ)⋆ψ)(x) = ((f⋆ψ)⋆φ)(x)
statement:
Let n ∈ ℕ and ℝⁿ = Euclid n with Lebesgue measure. Let f : ℝⁿ → ℝ be integrable, let φ, ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝ be continuous with compact support, and let x ∈ ℝⁿ. Then
∫ (∫ f(y)·φ(x − z − y) dy)·ψ(z) dz = ∫ (∫ f(y)·ψ(x − z − y) dy)·φ(z) dz.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f φ ψ : Euclid n → ℝ) (x : Euclid n), Integrable f → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → Continuous ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∫ z, (∫ y, f y * φ (x - z - y)) * ψ z = ∫ z, (∫ y, f y * ψ (x - z - y)) * φ z
